_source.why: The platform epic E3 conformance fixture (vault-vectors/pv-derivation.fixture.json) has NOT shipped. This file is NOT it and must never be renamed to it. It exists so the full section 4 chain has a regression oracle and so the Kotlin/BouncyCastle implementation is cross-checked against an INDEPENDENT implementation of the same specification - WebCrypto, which is the primitive apps/web itself derives through. It proves self-consistency and spec-agreement; it does NOT prove byte-identity with the platform, because nothing here came from the platform.
